answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with time-locked staking: every identity must lock a deposit that unlocks only after a long period of honest service, like a harbor admitting ships only after they wait out the tide. One operator cloning identities must fund each copy separately and wait the full term for every one, so fakery scales in capital and time, not for free. Honest agents earn stake back plus reputation, while a crystal-clear audit trail lets the river of transactions expose wallet clusters funded from one source before they profit.
